question: Should this timeline request wait for the metadata-only audit ledger and lifecycle security contract, or should maintainers intentionally scope a narrower ephemeral timeline surface now?
rationale: The user value is clear, but the implementation choice controls persistence, cross-session visibility, redaction, CLI/chat/TUI API shape, and whether this duplicates existing Activity or trajectory state.

options.title: Build on audit ledger first
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98521 to define durable metadata, authorization, redaction, ordering, and query semantics before adding timeline UI or CLI surfaces.

options.title: Approve ephemeral timeline only
options.body: Keep the surface live/session-local and derived from existing lifecycle/tool events, accepting that it will not satisfy durable historical JSON export.

options.title: Narrow or decline broad timeline
options.body: Keep Activity and trajectory export as the supported observability paths and close or narrow this request after documenting the product decision.

recommendation.title: Build on audit ledger first
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98521 to define durable metadata, authorization, redaction, ordering, and query semantics before adding timeline UI or CLI surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the related audit-ledger direction and appears in current history on the adjacent Activity and trajectory surfaces.
